grh_af5955331e52542d7363.title: My Favorite Wife
paragraphs: After seven years missing at sea, Ellen Arden returns home on the very day her husband Nick has finally had her declared legally dead and married Bianca. Matters get worse when Nick learns Ellen spent the shipwreck years on an island with another man, provoking a new round of jealousy and concealment.
